facts.fact: Rack Centre's spec sheet states that the cooling at its existing Lagos facility LGS1 delivers a design PUE of 1.5; the sheet gives no date of its own, so the published date 2024-05 is used.

note: LGS2 (PUE 1.35, gas turbine generation, 25 MVA utility supply) is described as under construction, so it gives no fact.
